document.title: GasGas Easter Fun Trial SCORE SHEET, Test No. 1 Lap 1 and Test No. 2 Lap 1
document.publisher: AJS Moto Trials Club of WA
document.notes: One page covering two of the event's test runs (tests 1 and 2 of lap 1). Per test: Orig Time (min.secs), Dabs, Fives, Tape Breaks (test 1) or Tape Penalty (test 2, still a count), Penalty Time (min.secs, printed mm:ss), Rank. 'Enter Time, Dabs, # Fives & # Tape Breaks in Coloured Cells' is printed above each block: the sheet is a data-entry template. The text layer misplaces some counts by one column; values were taken from the rendered page and checked against Penalty Time. Rows are in final-place order, not test order.

event.name: GasGas Easter Fun Trial
event.organiser: AJS Moto Trials Club of WA
event.notes: Sponsors printed on the sheet: GasGas, MotoDynamics.

rule_sets.name: GasGas Easter Fun Trial timed tests

penalties.as_printed: if you cross the tape or break the tape you will be “rewarded” with a 10 sec time penalty
for every dab you take, you will be awarded a 2 sec penalty
If you fall off, stall the bike, go backwards, miss a marker etc. you will receive a 5 sec penalty but ... you can re-mount, re-start and carry on

time.conversion: Test score = time from start gate to end gate + 2 s per dab + 5 s per five + 10 s per tape break; event score = sum of test scores, lowest wins.
time.notes: Times are keyed as min.secs: '1.5' means 1 min 50 s and '1.05' means 1 min 5 s.

source.title: 2022 GasGas Easter Fun Trial rules
source.clause: Intro 1-3; The Rules 1-4; note to observers and timers

rule_sets.notes: Dabs and fives count only inside the observed part at the end of each test, ridden on the rider's normal grade markers; before it a rider may foot, fall or stall without penalty. Tie-breaks are not stated. Trophies to the top 5 overall and a Most Memorable Ride Trophy (recipients not printed). 'Not suitable for Intro, Black Plate or Sidecars.'

misfits.what: Each run records counted infringements of three kinds (dabs, fives, tape breaks) that convert to seconds at different rates. ride.components can hold the seconds per kind, and ride.faults one integer, but there is no place for the counts themselves, which is what the sheet prints. penalty_s and the component values here are derived from the printed counts and the rule-sheet rates; the sheet itself prints only the counts and the resulting Penalty Time.
misfits.suggestion: Add ride.infringements[] {code, count, value_each, unit} (or let components carry a count).

misfits.what: A run's result cell reads 'RET' while its time, dabs and fives are still entered. ride.state has no 'retired' or 'did not finish' value and a ride has no status field, so the code went into x_status_as_printed with state 'unknown'.
misfits.suggestion: Add ride.status and ride.status_as_printed (same enum as totals), or add 'retired' to ride.state.

misfits.what: Equal Penalty Times are sometimes shared ranks (00:52, 00:55, 01:08, 01:12) and sometimes split (01:01 ranked 12 and 13; 01:02 ranked 14 and 15) with no printed reason. tie_break.rule has no 'not-stated' value, so 'other' with a note was used.

The score is a time printed as mm:ss; rows hold seconds and the printed string sits in x_value_as_printed because row has no value_as_printed. The raw entry format ('1.50' = 1:50) is kept in ride.as_printed only.

This file covers only two of the event's eight test runs (tests 1 and 2 of lap 1). The protocol cannot say a document is a partial view of an event, so a reader cannot tell missing tests from tests not ridden.
misfits.suggestion: Add document.covers (list of part ids) and document.related[] for the other files of the same event.

misfits.what: Each test is a timed run ending in an observed part ridden on grade markers; section.kind takes one value, so the observed part and its grade-dependent route sit in an x_ key.
misfits.suggestion: Allow sub-parts on a section (timed run + observed part with its own route rule).

mapping.unread: Nothing unread. Values were read from the rendered page (90 dpi) because the text layer shifts some counts by a column; every sampled run satisfies Orig Time + 2 s x dabs + 5 s x fives + 10 s x tape = Penalty Time. The 18 riders outside the original sample were added later from the text layer, with each run's counts assigned to dabs, fives and tape breaks by solving against Penalty Time; the parser's output matched every hand-mapped run that has a time.
